tool_notes.voice_lines: After the whole script is polished, voice many cuts in one call (up to 80 cuts per call; call it in parts if there are more). Write the returned seconds and audio into each cut as they are. After a change, voice only the changed cuts again. The totals it returns (all_voiced_so_far) cover every cut voiced so far and are for information only; there is no target to meet.
tool_notes.voice_upload: After every cut is voiced from its final line, upload each cut's voice file, up to 10 per call: file = the audio path voice_lines returned, title = the cut_id (c01, c02, ...), description = "voice of <cut_id>: <first words of the line>", source = "Kokoro voice (draft or final)". Upload a cut again only if you voiced it again. Do this before save_output.

part_id.description: the part id of the cut's scene, copied from the storyboard (p1, p2, ...)

scene_n.description: the n of the cut's scene, copied from the storyboard

seconds.description: the seconds voice_lines returned for this cut, as is

audio.description: the audio file path voice_lines returned for this cut, as is
